title: Split deterministic tool registry by tool responsibility
description:
Refactor packages/core/src/orchestrator/tools.ts into a tool registry plus separate modules for individual tools.

Current tool responsibilities include rolling dice, marking scenes, rules lookup, state mutation, world query, and memory drilldown. These should be easier to review and test independently.
acceptance_criteria:
- ToolRegistry remains provider-neutral.
- Each default tool has a focused module.
- Rules lookup, state mutation, world query, memory drilldown, roll, and scene-marking logic are separated.
- Existing tool tests pass.
- No model-facing tool names change unless explicitly migrated.
close_reason: Refactored tools.ts into 7 focused modules: toolRegistry, toolRoll, toolMarkScene, toolLookupRules, toolMutateState, toolWorldQuery, toolMemoryDrilldown. tools.ts is now a thin assembly/re-export module. All 487 tests pass, Biome clean.
